description: Configure this tenant's search index provider. provider: "none" (lexical only, the default) or "openai-compatible" (endpoint, model, and secret -- a tenant secret name used as the embeddings request's bearer -- all required). Changing config re-indexes every document from scratch in the background.

dims.description: Expected embedding dimensionality, for documentation purposes.

endpoint.description: Embeddings API URL; required for openai-compatible.

model.description: Embeddings model name; required for openai-compatible.

secret.description: Name of a tenant secret (host.secret_set) used as the bearer; required for openai-compatible.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.docs.index_config
